lines.zh: 我扇着翅膀，在蕨叶间穿行。
lines.en: I beat my wings and thread through the ferns.

lines.zh: 我贴得很低，怕被大东西看见。
lines.en: I fly low, afraid the big things will see me.

lines.zh: 我从这朵花飘到那朵花。
lines.en: I drift from flower to flower.

lines.zh: 翅膀一拍，我就升了半尺。
lines.en: One wingbeat lifts me half a foot.
I circle a tree stump.
I ride the warm wind up the slope.

lines.zh: 我拐了个弯，躲开一片叶。
lines.en: I turn to miss a leaf.

lines.zh: 我一上一下，像被风抛着。
lines.en: I rise and dip as if tossed by wind.
I fly toward that shaft of sun.

lines.zh: 我停在一片大叶的边上。
lines.en: I settle at the edge of a big leaf.
I lift off again and go deeper.
I look for gaps among the vines.

lines.zh: 我慢慢降落在一块石头上。
lines.en: I come down slowly on a stone.

lines.zh: 我绕开一只大虫，飞高些。
lines.en: I veer around a big insect and rise.
I cross a little stretch of water.

lines.zh: 我朝着有颜色的地方飞。
lines.en: I fly toward whatever has color.

lines.zh: 我停了一下，又换了方向。
lines.en: I pause and choose another direction.

lines.zh: 我的翅在光里闪了一下。
lines.en: My wings flash once in the light.

lines.zh: 我栖在花上，双翅缓缓启合。
lines.en: I perch on the flower, wings opening slowly.

lines.zh: 口器探进花心，找到那点甜。
lines.en: My mouthparts find the sweet at the flower's heart.
The sun warms my wings.

lines.zh: 我定住不动，把力气留着。
lines.en: I hold still and husband my strength.
A gust pushes me off line.
I shake my wings into order.

lines.zh: 我守着一朵还没张开的蕾。
lines.en: I keep watch on a bud not yet open.
I rest a while under a leaf.
I see more flowers further off.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀合上，像一片叶。
lines.en: I fold my wings and look like a leaf.

lines.zh: 我这副翅膀撑不了几个日落。
lines.en: These wings won't last many sunsets.

lines.zh: 树下的脚步声，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear the steps under the tree.

lines.zh: 我飞到你面前，绕了半圈。
lines.en: I fly before you and make half a turn.
Your colors are bright.
I land on your shoulder.
I move and you look over.
I settle on the leaf by your hand.
I am close but do not touch you.

lines.zh: 你挪了半步，我的花就暗了。
lines.en: Half a step from you and my flower goes dim.
I fly off a little and come back.
I loop once around you.

lines.zh: 你的影子让我看不清花。
lines.en: Your shadow hides the flowers from me.
The blow sends me dropping.
One of my wings is notched.
I fly crooked and cannot settle.
I hit a leaf and stop.
I lie there a good while before rising.
Most of my strength is gone.

lines.zh: 我一头扎进花叶最密处。
lines.en: I dive into the thickest of the blooms.
I can still fly, only sluggishly.
I write that in my wing veins.
My days are nearly spent.
The nectar smells sweet.
I fly to the bloom in your hand.
I settle on the petal and sip slowly.
This one has opened to its fullest.
One sip done, I find another.
My legs are dusty with pollen.
Hold still; I will be quick.
I circle once in the flower's heart.
There is not much nectar here.

lines.zh: 我起了一下，还是落回原处。
lines.en: I lift, then drop back where I was.
One knock and I fly off at a slant.
I am thrown a good way off.

lines.zh: 我连扇几下把身子摆正。
lines.en: A few quick beats set me right.

lines.zh: 我这点分量，一阵风就吹走。
lines.en: A gust is enough to carry my weight off.
I hit your hand and lift again.
I settle back on the flower as if nothing happened.
I slip past the side of your shoulder.
I nearly touched your face.
I withdraw to the flowering side.
You are too strong for me.

lines.zh: 我绕着它飞，一圈接一圈。
lines.en: I wheel around it, loop on loop.
The two of us settle on one bloom.
It lifts off and I follow.
Our wings nearly touch.

lines.zh: 我们一上一下，拍子相合。
lines.en: We rise and dip on matching beats.
I stop on the leaf beside it.

lines.zh: 我一靠近，它就让开一点。
lines.en: I come near and it drifts a little off.
We wheel the flower two turns.
It flies into the trees and I go too.
We scatter and meet again.
I settle in the flower's heart and sip.
I hold the stamen with my forelegs.
This flower is too small.
I taste it; very thin.
The nectar sticks to my feet.
I brush it and carry pollen away.
This one is already empty.
I move to another.
I rub some pollen onto the petal.
I take only a little.

lines.zh: 有影子掠过，我马上飞起。
lines.en: A shadow passes and I take off at once.
I have that movement marked.
I hover first to see it clearly.
Too close, so I rise.
I first shrink behind a leaf.
I circle, waiting for it to go.
The wind carries it closer.
I close my wings and pass for a leaf.
I see clearly: that is not a flower.
One move will give me away.
I loop above its head.
When it moves, I climb.
I withdraw among the twigs.
I keep watching its hands.
I cling beneath the leaf and dare not move.
It is still below me.
I count the times it breathes.
I want to leave but fear being seen.
The wind hides me from it.
One more beat and I fly.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一扇抽在它脸上。
lines.en: One beat of my wings slaps its face.
I bump it, light as dust.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，轻得像片柳絮。
lines.en: I bump you, light as a drifting seed.
Not even the scales were stirred.
I beat my wings and get clear.
I lunge once more.
It swats and I retreat.

lines.zh: 我这身子不是用来斗的。
lines.en: This body was not made to fight.
I settle on a twig and pant.
I fight no more.
I break from the chrysalis with wet wings.
I hang under the leaf until they dry.
First of all, find flowers.
I try a short flight.
The ferns are tall here.
I wheel over this patch of blooms.
The wind pushes me off course.
The sun is good and I rise.
I settle on a big leaf.
I have only a few days.
I dodge a big insect.
I want to see this wood.
One lick of flame and my wings curl.
I fall to the ground and roll over.
Water glues me and my wings will not open.
The blast hurls me far.

lines.zh: 一道东西擦过翅面，撕开了。
lines.en: Something grazes my wing and splits it.

lines.zh: 冷意罩住我，我飞不起来。
lines.en: Cold settles on me and I cannot fly.
Too long without nectar and my wings soften.
Lightning flashes and I press to the leaf.
The wind wraps me and I drop.
